silhouette.reason: Lumpy body with craters and protruding glowing crystals reads as a mineable asteroid; the FRONT view still has a flat vertical cut face on its right side and the hero is a smooth potato.
fixes: replace the large flat fracture plane with 2–3 smaller angled facets so no side reads as a cut wall
deeper craters and one or two boulder-scale lumps to break the potato outline

proportions.reason: Blocky ~11 × 10 × 6.7 m body; within the range of small rubble-pile bodies and different from the other variants.
fixes: one shallow saddle/neck so the body reads as a contact binary like Itokawa

materials.reason: Crystals are crisp cyan and the ore veins are now broad orange bands, but the bands read as painted stripes (a tennis-ball seam in hero.png) rather than veins, the hero regolith shows contour-line rings (iso-line banding) across the grey, and every sheet.png view still stair-steps the colour edges in square blocks.
fixes: break the orange bands into branching veins of varying width that follow fractures, not great circles
remove the contour-line banding in the regolith (smooth the quantised colour/height field that draws iso-rings in hero.png)
carry the per-pixel colour into the vertex colour (or sample per pixel in every renderer) so the sheet views stop stair-stepping

detail.reason: Crater pits read in the sheet, but at hero distance the body is a smooth blob with soft dents; no rubble shows in hero.png and the crater rims are soft.
fixes: a finer secondary noise octave at LOD0 for rock grain and sharper crater rims (raised lip, steeper inner wall)
rubble as irregular chips (random-plane cut cells) instead of cube-like blocks

wear.reason: A cyan stain round the crystal site; no ejecta rays, drill scars or tailings, and the crater ages are indistinguishable.
fixes: bright fresh ejecta rays around the youngest crater, darker space-weathered older surfaces
drill scars and tailings piles at the crystal mining sites

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 now keeps the orange vein colour as per-face patches and the crystals, so the colour read survives the switch; but the faces are large and flat-shaded, giving a harsher light/dark patchwork than LOD0.
fixes: smooth the LOD2 normals and add ~30% more faces so the patchwork softens at the switch

technical.reason: QA clean; ~18-20k / 2k / 0.3k triangles over 2 draws (body + glowing crystals), proportionate to a hero rock.
fixes: shrink the sdf bounds to the body extent to cut build time and spend the saved LOD0 budget on crater rims
